lines: Ae ishq hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: Love, do not lay us waste.

lines: Ae ishq na chhed aa aa ke hamein
couplets.en: Love, turn away when you would come to trouble us again.

lines: Hum bhoole huon ko yaad na kar
couplets.en: Spare us the memory of those we have forgotten.

lines: Pehle hi bahut nashaad hain hum
couplets.en: We have sorrow enough already.

lines: Tu aur hamein nashaad na kar
couplets.en: Spare us any further sorrow.

lines: Qismat ka sitam hi kam nahin kuchh
couplets.en: Fate has been cruel enough.

lines: Yeh taaza sitam ijaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not devise a fresh cruelty.

lines: Yun zulm na kar, bedaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not be so cruel to us.

lines: Ae ishq hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: Love, do not lay us waste.

lines: Raaton ko uth uth kar rote hain
couplets.en: Night after night we wake in tears.

lines: Ro ro ke duaein karte hain
couplets.en: We pray through our tears.

lines: Aankhon mein tasavvur, dil mein khalish
couplets.en: Your image fills our eyes, and an ache fills the heart.

lines: Sar dhunte hain, aahein bharte hain
couplets.en: We shake our heads and sigh.

lines: Ae ishq yeh kaisa rog laga
couplets.en: Love, what sickness have you brought upon us?

lines: Jeete hain na zaalim marte hain
couplets.en: Cruel one, we can neither live nor die.

lines: In khwaabon se yun aazaad na kar
couplets.en: Leave us these dreams.

lines: Ae ishq hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: Love, do not lay us waste.

lines: Jis din se bandha hai dhyaan tera
couplets.en: Since the day our thoughts first turned to you.

lines: Ghabraaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We have scarcely known a moment of ease.

lines: Har waqt tasavvur kar kar ke
couplets.en: We picture you again and again.

lines: Sharmaaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We go about with downcast eyes.

lines: Kumhlaaye hue phoolon ki tarah
couplets.en: We are like flowers that have wilted.

lines: Kumhlaaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We live as though our bloom has faded.

lines: Paamaal na kar, bedaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not crush us with such cruelty.

lines: Ae ishq hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: Love, do not lay us waste.
